vetSays.line: 🛡️ Eduardo, Violet, Emmett and Manpreet met them at the door — 4 put down. Eduardo, Violet, Emmett, Manpreet are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Renato, David and Sanne met them at the door — 3 put down. Renato, David, Sanne are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? David just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sanne just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ David and Sanne met them at the door — 2 put down. David, Sanne are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? David just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Emmett, Renato, David and Sanne met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 barely walked away. Emmett, Renato, David, Sanne are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sanne just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Emmett and Sanne met them at the door — 2 put down. Emmett is hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

log: R1: Elijah walks in open-handed, talking — low, steady, unafraid. And impossibly, it listens. It stands down. (Peacemaker: Walk In)
R1: Elijah walks in open-handed — and it goes wrong. It doesn't want peace. They're exposed, off-balance. (Walk In — failed)
still off-balance from the failed parley, Elijah takes it worse. (Peacemaker — exposed)
R1: Final Chapter hits Elijah for 43 (52 left)
R2: Final Chapter hits Elijah for 34 (18 left)
Elijah is losing — shouts for help! Emmett charges in!
Emmett answered Elijah's shout, but Elijah is past holding — they run while running still works.

regDeaths.name: a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
a red moon rising between the trees, breathing
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still
